capture.clipSaved.context: Native toast. Length is the duration of the saved replay.

capture.clipSavedUnderSecond.context: Confirmation when a replay file contains less than one second of footage.

capture.clipSavedUnknown.context: Confirmation when a replay file was saved but its duration could not be read.

capture.recordingStarted.context: Native toast after an OBS recording starts.

capture.recordingStopped.context: Native toast after an OBS recording stops.

clips.selectedCount.context: Count of selected cards in the Clips bulk-action toolbar.

clips.showInClips.context: Home card action that reveals the clip in the Clips library.

common.close.context: Dismisses a dialog. Matches OBS's Close message.

notifications.deletedHint.context: Below Notification not found in the reader.

notifications.notFound.context: Heading in the notification reader when an item has disappeared.

notifications.openReleasePage.context: Button opening the GitHub release associated with a notification.

picker.iconImage.context: Windows file picker title for an account or app icon.

picker.importMedia.context: Editor image and GIF picker title.

projector.lock.context: Projector bar toggle while the preview is unlocked. A verb: pressing it locks the preview so the scene cannot be moved.

projector.locked.context: Projector bar toggle while the preview is locked. Describes the state.

settings.languageNotSaved.context: Settings warning when OBS did not confirm the picked language, so nothing was changed.
settings.languageNotSaved.text: The language was not changed because OBS did not answer. Try again.

storage.compressFailed.context: Added after a compression result when some clips failed. Count is the number of clips that failed.

storage.compressFailedWithError.context: Added after a compression result when some clips failed. Error is the reason.

storage.compressed.context: Compression result popup, under Space freed.

storage.compressedFreed.context: Compression result notice. Size is the space freed, such as 1.2 GB.

storage.compressedFreedStopped.context: Compression result notice after the user stopped it. Size is the space freed.

text.one: Compressed {count} clip and freed {size} before it was stopped.
text.other: Compressed {count} clips and freed {size} before it was stopped.
